verdict.rationale: API-versus-UI parity is a fair axis for a hardware security key, since keys in this category can ship management tooling, so this is 'none' rather than 'na'. The probe records that Titan ships no vendor CLI, SDK, API, or MCP surface of its own. Enrollment, removal, reset and unpairing are all documented only as manual steps in account settings or on the device itself, and fleet management runs through a separate product (the Workspace Admin console).
